shared_access_banner.heading: Give access to APIs without handing out secrets
shared_access_banner.body: <0>Passport by Postman</0> lets you grant granular, time-bound API access to any developer or AI agent. Secrets never leave your cloud, every call is audited, and access can be revoked in one click.

local_reference_banner.heading: Securely call APIs without storing secrets
local_reference_banner.body: <0>Passport by Postman</0> lets you call APIs using a reference instead, the real value is never held on this machine.
